summary: A development launch no longer stalls on the splash screen waiting for a server that cannot start.
details: Running the app server under pythonw.exe left uvicorn without a stderr stream, so it exited with code 1 before binding its port.
Only the supervisor now runs under pythonw; the app server keeps the console interpreter and stays windowless through Electron's hidden spawn.
The supervisor also redirects its child to the null device when its own streams are absent.
